resources.string: Prescription Verification, Item Master Matching & Counter Sale Bridge
Standalone Bridge Mode: PySide6/SQLite Counter Sale connector is not actively connected. Approved prescriptions are queued with recoverable claim locks and structured JSON export.

No AI API key or endpoint is configured. Configure AI_API_KEY in the AI Studio Secrets panel (.env) and set your endpoint/model in Settings before running automated prescription extraction. You can still manually transcribe and review fields.
